The first chords most guitarists learn are the open chords E minor, A minor, C, G, D and E major. Press the strings just behind the frets with the fingertips, keep the thumb behind the neck and arch the fingers so they do not mute neighbouring strings. Changing between chords cleanly matters more than speed, so practise switching slowly with a metronome for a minute at a time. Fingertips hurt for the first few weeks until calluses form.
